validation_rules: the orchestrator overwrites source_revision, target, index, classification, toolchain, dispositions and every citation content_hash; it also derives root and class from the classification, orders commands and drops repeated packages

the orchestrator runs the acceptance checks (one plan for this unit, catalog base image, argv rules, compiler and fetch rules, cwd inside the root, signal ids, tier C gaps, citation freshness) inside the repair loop: a rejected answer comes back with the errors to fix
a plan still rejected after the repair rounds gets one fresh call with the rejection reason; after that the unit becomes a 'no build plan' coverage gap
